items.title: 3 REITs to Beat Rising Interest Rates, According to a Real Estate Pro
items.summary: Rising interest rates are a headwind for real estate investment trusts.  It has been a difficult period for real estate stocks, with elevated interest rates, dismal demand for corporate office space and a snarled housing market.  This was supposed to be a comeback year with the Fed easing interest rates as inflation cooled.

items.title: Cipher Digital Stock Is Valued On Revenue It Is Shutting Down
items.summary: The sales multiple every screen shows is measured against a bitcoin business the company is decommissioning, while the data center rent it is actually being valued for has only just begun.

items.title: 5 of JP Morgan’s Top Stock Picks Pay Big Dividends and One Yields Over 12%
items.summary: J.P. Morgan updates its Analyst Focus List every month, and the August edition quietly signals where the firm's top analysts are placing their highest-conviction bets, including a handful of dividend payers that could surprise income investors hunting for yield in a market trading near all-time highs.

items.title: Data Centers Vault Northern Virginia To CRE Top Spot
items.summary: Northern Virginia overtook Dallas as the top US CRE market in H1 2026, fueled by massive data center deals and targeted investment.

items.title: Is DLR Worth Buying as Growth Accelerates but Valuation Stays Rich?
items.summary: DLR's growth outlook is strengthening on AI, cloud and enterprise demand, but rich valuation and a larger development program raise execution stakes.

items.title: DLR Jumps 9.9% in the Past Month as Leasing Momentum Accelerates
items.summary: DLR's 9.9% monthly gain reflects record leasing backlog, strong renewal pricing and a larger pre-leased development pipeline.

items.title: APLD Surges 101% in a Year: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.summary: Applied Digital's 101% rally faces mounting risks from heavy capital needs, high debt, competition, weaker earnings estimates and an expensive valuation.
